* Ready to run
* Hungry and driven by urgency
* Exceptional at what they do, with low ego
* Comfortable operating in motion

The role
  
  
Software Engineers at OnePay build the products & systems that serve our customers and run our company. Besides writing, reviewing, and shipping code, engineers collaborate with others across the company, from product, design, and data to, customer support, ops, and compliance. Software Engineers at OnePay are highly technical, communicative, and emotionally intelligent.

Neolytix is a US-headquartered healthcare technology and services company with delivery centres in Chicago, Gurugram, and Manila, supporting 270+ provider organizations. As we move from a services company to a technology-enabled one, our Intelligent Automation team is building the AI platform and the AI-native automations that healthcare operations will run on.
  
  
We are hiring an Associate – AI & Automation Developer with 1-2 year of hands-on experience and real project work. This is a builder’s role: you will own AI projects end to end — Python services, LLM integrations, retrieval pipelines, agents and workflow automations — that operations teams use every day, inside a secure environment designed for protected health information.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Own AI projects end to end — from understanding the process with operations teams to design, build, testing and deployment.
* Build Python / FastAPI services with a React front end and a PostgreSQL or Azure SQL data layer.
* Integrate LLM APIs into production: prompt design, structured output, RAG over internal documents, and conversational assistants.
* Build agents that run on NeoForge, and automation workflows in n8n — including migrating the existing Power Automate portfolio.
* Build document and data extraction automations (PDFs, EOBs, bank statements) and validate accuracy against a test set before release.
* Deploy and run what you build on Azure — containerised services, background jobs and scheduled workers — inside a HIPAA-aligned environment.
* Maintain and extend existing production systems, and document your work so the business can run it without a developer.

What You'll Work On
  
  

* The secure AI platform — the PHI-safe environment every AI workflow runs inside. Architecture, integration and deployment, alongside DevOps.
* AI assistants for operations — retrieval-based assistants used by Medical Billing and Credentialing, built over internal knowledge bases and operational data.
* The n8n automation lane — new AI-native workflows, plus migration of the existing portfolio onto one platform.
* Document intelligence — extraction and validation automations across the documents that drive revenue-cycle work.
* NeoSutra and NeoForge — build and extend features on these Neolytix platforms, including agents that run on NeoForge.
* Upcoming automations — a growing pipeline of new AI automations across healthcare operations.

What You Bring
  
  
Must-Have
  
  

* 1–2 years of hands-on experience (minimum 1 year) building and shipping software, including at least one AI or LLM project that reached real users — not only coursework or a tutorial build.
* Strong Python, and experience building APIs with a modern framework (FastAPI preferred).
* Practical experience calling LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI or similar): prompt design, structured output, and handling cost, latency and failure cases.
* Has built at least one retrieval (RAG) system end to end — embeddings, chunking and vector search (pgvector or similar).
* Experience building LLM agents with tool / function calling (LangChain, LangGraph or similar).
* Workflow automation with n8n, including LLM calls inside workflows.
* SQL and relational databases — PostgreSQL, Azure SQL or equivalent — and REST API integration with third-party services.
* Docker, and deploying and running a service on a cloud platform — Azure strongly preferred.
* Background and asynchronous job processing — Celery, Redis queues or equivalent.
* Working front-end knowledge — React or similar, enough to build and wire up a usable interface.
* Git, and the habit of writing clean code another developer can pick up.
* Good spoken and written English, ownership and timeline discipline — you take a commitment seriously and raise a problem early.

**Preferred (a Bonus, Not Required)**

* OCR and document AI services — Azure Document Intelligence or similar.
* LLM gateway and observability tooling — LiteLLM, Langfuse or similar.

* Exposure to US healthcare, HIPAA, or any regulated-data environment.

Eligibility Criteria
  
  

* Education: B.Tech, BCA, MCA (Computer Science), completed — candidates currently pursuing a degree or with backlogs are not eligible.
* Experience: 1–2 years post-graduation (minimum 1 year hands-on) with demonstrable project work; a GitHub profile or portfolio preferred.

* Availability: this is a backfill position — immediate joiners or candidates on a short notice period are strongly preferred.

Selection Process
  
  

* Application review — resume plus GitHub or portfolio.
* Technical assessment — a short practical task in Python involving an LLM API call.
* Technical interview with the Intelligent Automation team — walk us through something you built end to end.

Build Real AI Products
  
  
What you build runs in a live healthcare business and is used daily — not pilots that get shelved.

Work on the secure AI platform the whole function depends on, with real architectural input.

You touch backend, AI, automation and front end — not one narrow slice of a pipeline.

* Build the interfaces security teams work in daily: finding triage, exploit evidence review, remediation and retest tracking, agent run inspection, and reporting.
* Design backend services and APIs for scanning, agent execution, evidence storage, and integrations with code hosts, CI/CD, ticketing systems, and cloud accounts.
* Build product surfaces on top of LLMs and autonomous agents, including streaming output, long-running task state, human approval steps, partial results, and graceful failure.
* Turn AppSec workflows into product: finding deduplication, severity and reachability context, ownership routing, SLA tracking, and verification that fixes actually close the vulnerability.
* Design schemas and pipelines for findings, agent trajectories, evidence artifacts, and audit trails.
* Build multi-tenant foundations including authentication, authorization, RBAC, org and project scoping, audit logging, secrets handling, and tenant isolation.
* Make agent behavior legible in the interface: what the agent did, what it proved, what it could not, and where a human needs to decide.
* Own performance, reliability, latency, and cost across the stack, including inference and tool-execution cost surfaced to the user.
* Set engineering standards for code review, testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, and secure-by-default patterns, and treat our own attack surface as a first-class concern.
* Prototype quickly with design partners, put working software in front of practitioners early, and decide what is ready to ship.

* Strong full-stack ability: modern TypeScript and React on the front end, plus backend work in Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, or Rust.
* Hands-on experience building application-security products, or closely adjacent ones such as code security, vulnerability management, attack-surface management, DevSecOps, offensive-security tooling, or SOC platforms.

* Experience designing APIs, data models, and asynchronous or long-running workflows.
* Front-end craft on data-dense technical interfaces, including state management, streaming and real-time updates, and performance under large result sets.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and production operations.
* Ability to scope ambiguous problems, make architectural decisions, and raise the bar for other engineers through code and review rather than process.

* Experience building products on LLMs or agents, including tool use, streaming, evaluations, prompt and model versioning, and latency and cost tradeoffs.

* Experience integrating with GitHub or GitLab, CI systems, Jira or ServiceNow, SIEM and EDR platforms, or cloud provider APIs.
* Experience meeting enterprise requirements such as SSO, SAML, SCIM, audit logging, VPC or on-premise deployment, and air-gapped installs.
* Experience with real-time systems, websockets, job queues, or event-driven architectures.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
**Overview**
**WELCOME TO SITA**
At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
  
  
You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a
**Great Place to Work**
® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
  
  
Are you ready to love your job?
  
  
The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
  
  
**The role**
Join
**SITA Lab**
, where we explore emerging technologies and turn promising ideas into working solutions that could change how air transport operates.
  
  
You will work with airports, airlines, SITA teams, technology partners and start-ups to identify difficult industry problems, rapidly explore potential solutions, and build real-world prototypes and pilots.
  
  
Modern AI and agentic development tools have fundamentally changed how we engineer software. We expect our engineers to use AI extensively to research, design, build, test and evolve solutions. Your value is not measured by how many lines of code you personally write, but by how effectively you turn ideas into high-quality working systems.
  
  
As Lead Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across SITA Lab initiatives and help evolve how the Lab itself engineers software in an AI-native environment.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Explore
  
  

* Investigate emerging technologies and assess how they could solve real problems in aviation.
* Work directly with customers and subject-matter experts to understand operational problems, challenge assumptions and identify opportunities.
* Rapidly evaluate technologies, start-ups, open-source projects, APIs, models and platforms.
* Lead technical discovery, experimentation and design-thinking activities.
* Turn loosely defined ideas into hypotheses that can be tested with working software.

Engineer
  
  

* Design and build prototypes, proofs of concept and pilot solutions, moving from idea to working system quickly.
* Use modern AI-assisted and agentic software-development techniques throughout the engineering lifecycle.
* Decompose complex engineering objectives into tasks that can be effectively executed by people and AI agents.
* Provide agents with the appropriate context, requirements, constraints, architecture and acceptance criteria.
* Build the tests, evaluations and observability needed to verify AI-generated solutions rather than trusting generated output.
* Integrate APIs, enterprise systems, data sources, AI models and existing SITA capabilities into end-to-end solutions.
* Move comfortably between languages, frameworks and platforms rather than being constrained by a single technology stack.

Lead
  
  

* Own technical direction and architecture for Lab initiatives from initial experiment through customer pilot.
* Make pragmatic engineering decisions that balance experimentation speed, quality, security and maintainability.
* Establish effective patterns for collaborative engineering between people and AI agents.
* Review and challenge designs and implementations produced by both engineers and AI agents.
* Mentor engineers in architecture, engineering judgement and effective use of AI development tools.
* Identify when an AI-generated solution is superficially plausible but fundamentally wrong.
* Decide when to prototype rapidly and when a solution requires production-grade engineering controls.

Deliver responsibly
  
  

* Ensure solutions have appropriate automated testing, security controls, observability and documentation.
* Apply secure engineering practices when using AI agents, particularly around credentials, customer data, tool access and external systems.
* Define appropriate operating boundaries and human approval points for autonomous systems.
* Work within SITA architecture, security and AI-governance requirements while maintaining the pace expected from an innovation Lab.

Influence
  
  

* Demonstrate new technologies and solutions to customers and senior stakeholders.
* Explain complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Collaborate across SITA, customers, industry groups, open-source communities and technology partners.
* Help transfer successful Lab experiments into SITA product and operational environments.

**Who You Are**
You are an experienced engineer who is excited rather than threatened by the changing nature of software engineering.
  
  

* You have excellent software-engineering fundamentals and architectural judgement.
* You are an active and sophisticated user of AI-assisted and agentic development tools.
* You can demonstrate examples where AI materially changed the way you engineered or delivered software.
* You understand that using an AI coding agent effectively requires much more than writing prompts.
* You know how to provide agents with context, constraints and acceptance criteria, and how to validate their output.
* You can quickly understand an unfamiliar repository, technology or domain.
* You are comfortable allowing an agent to implement something you could implement yourself, and equally comfortable taking control when engineering judgement requires it.
* You think in terms of systems, interfaces, events, data flows and failure modes rather than individual code files.
* You naturally experiment, learn and adapt.
* You thrive with ambiguous problems where neither the requirements nor the solution are obvious.
* You prefer building and testing something to spending weeks debating whether it might work.
* You can move comfortably between architecture, coding, customer conversations and technical leadership.
* You can lead and mentor other engineers without becoming the bottleneck.

**Qualifications**
**Technical experience**
**Essential**

* Significant professional experience designing, building and operating software systems.
* Strong software-engineering fundamentals, including architecture, APIs, distributed systems, testing, security and observability.
* Hands-on capability in at least one mainstream programming ecosystem, with the ability to become productive rapidly in others.
* Practical experience using modern AI coding tools or coding agents as part of real software engineering.
* Experience with cloud-native architectures, containers and Kubernetes.
* Experience designing distributed, event-driven and API-based systems.
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs and modern integration interfaces.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL data stores.
* Strong understanding of Git-based development, CI/CD, automated testing and DevOps practices.
* Experience leading technical projects and mentoring engineers.

**Highly desirable**

* Java and Spring Boot and/or Python.
* TypeScript or JavaScript and modern web frameworks.
* Azure and/or AWS.
* Kafka or equivalent event-streaming technologies.
* LLM APIs and AI application architectures.
* Agentic systems, tool or function calling, MCP or equivalent tool-integration patterns.
* AI evaluation, tracing and observability.
* Experience taking prototypes through to customer pilots or production.
* Experience in aviation, airports, airlines or the wider travel industry.

**What Success Looks Like**

* You convert uncertain customer or industry problems into testable technical hypotheses.
* You use AI agents to increase delivery speed without lowering engineering, security or governance standards.
* You create working demonstrations and pilots that generate evidence, learning and clear next decisions.
* You improve the technical capability of the wider Lab team and reduce dependency on individual experts.
* You help successful experiments progress towards robust product or operational adoption.

**What We Offer**
We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
  
  
🏡
**Flex Week:**
Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)
  
  
⏰

Make your workday suit your life and plans.

Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
  
  
🌿

We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
  
  
🚀

At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From

and

-available to all employees-to specialized solutions like

for technology upskilling,

for people leadership,

for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.
  
  
🙌

Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

We are seeking a strong Senior Applied Scientist to join the Vertical Search Relevance team. As a Senior Applied Scientist On The Team, You Will Lead Science Innovation To Improve The Customer Search Experience Across Verticals. You Will
  
  

* Build and deploy machine learning models for Product Search ranking and relevance that serve billions of search requests.

* PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* 6+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience
* Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning

* Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
* Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

* 10+ years of hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and modern web development; working knowledge of React, Redux, Node.js, JavaScript, and HTML
* 5+ years architecting cloud-native solutions on Azure, AWS, or GCP using containers, Kubernetes, serverless services, Infrastructure-as-Code, and multi-tenant patterns
* Experience with modernization, cloud migration, platform transformation, lifecycle management, disaster recovery, and business continuity
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, including MongoDB, data modelling, performance optimisation, and scalability patterns
* Experience with event streaming technologies such as Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, or equivalent
* Expertise in designing scalable, secure, resilient, high-performance distributed systems and defining architecture standards, roadmaps, patterns, and reference architectures
* Solid knowledge of application and cloud security, identity and access management, OWASP Top 10, threat modelling, vulnerability remediation, and compliance controls
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, design patterns, Domain-Driven Design, microservices, performance engineering, capacity planning, and observability
* Demonstrated ability to lead architecture governance, technical workshops, and cross-team decisions while balancing business outcomes, security, cost, delivery, and sustainability
* Proven excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills
* Proven architecture leadership across multiple products, applications, teams, or enterprise platforms

**Vice President, Lead Data Platform Engineer**

**architecting complex streaming solutions, robust data pipeline architectures, and scalable microservices**
. This platform empowers quantitative scientists and traders to rapidly iterate on and deploy cutting-edge analytical and trading tools. We are looking for a polyglot expert who can directly contribute across diverse technology stacks, guide technical direction, and elevate the skills of junior engineers through direct technical leadership.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Hands-on Technical Leadership & Coaching: Provide technical leadership through direct code contribution, architecture review, and hands-on guidance to junior and mid-level data engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning across polyglot environments.
* Drive & Implement Architecture & Design: Directly contribute to and drive the technical design and hands-on development of highly scalable, low-latency, fault-tolerant data pipelines, real-time streaming platforms (e.g., Flink), and microservices architectures.
* Platform Infrastructure & Operations Deep Dive: Actively participate in the strategic planning, setup, enhancement, migration, and operational excellence of critical platform infrastructure, including distributed streaming (Flink) and high-performance caching solutions (Redis).
* Open Source & Emerging Technologies Evaluation: Continuously research, evaluate, and prototype emerging open-source data and streaming technologies, leading their integration into Citi's data platform through direct implementation. This includes evaluating new streaming frameworks and caching solutions.
* Performance & Resilience Optimization: Proactively identify and implement architectural and systemic performance optimizations to ensure optimal efficiency, responsiveness, and resilience across the entire data platform, including Flink and Redis clusters.
* Cross-Functional Technical Collaboration: Collaborate closely with senior technical stakeholders across engineering, data science, and business teams to translate complex technical requirements into robust, high-impact implementations.
* Delivery & Code Quality Assurance: Drive the timely, high-quality, and secure delivery of data platform features, championing agile methodologies, engineering best practices, and ensuring accountability for code quality and robust testing.
* Technical Problem Solving: Act as a primary escalation point for complex technical challenges, providing expert diagnosis and hands-on resolution.
* Operational Flexibility: May occasionally work a non-standard shift including nights and/or weekends and/or have on-call responsibilities to support critical platform operations.

**Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of demonstrable and highly hands-on experience in software development, with at least 3-5 years in a lead technical contributor or staff engineer role within a data-intensive environment.
* Deep Architectural & Implementation Expertise: Proven expertise in designing, building, and implementing Microservices and complex streaming/data pipeline architectures.
* Polyglot Proficiency & Technical Authority: Demonstrated ability to be a technical authority and actively contribute across multiple programming languages/frameworks, with strong hands-on experience in Java (Java 11+ preferred), and significant expertise in Python, along with practical knowledge of front-end technologies like Angular/React.
* Expertise in Flink Ecosystem: In-depth architectural understanding and hands-on experience with Apache Flink for real-time stream processing, including Flink SQL, DataStream API, and state management. Comprehensive knowledge of Flink infrastructure setup, maintenance, enhancement, migration strategies, and experience in evaluating/integrating alternative streaming frameworks.
* Mastery of Redis: In-depth knowledge and practical experience with Redis, encompassing not only data structures, caching patterns, and pub/sub mechanisms but also strategic expertise in Redis cluster setup, maintenance, enhancement, and migration strategies for mission-critical, high-performance applications.

description:
